prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1401; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was turning left when it struck a vehicle traveling straight through. Claimant reports a wrist fracture and has retained counsel. All further contact to go through claimant's attorney.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from insured. Insured states the left turn was made on a green arrow and the oncoming vehicle entered the intersection at speed. Insured has no visible injuries. Photos of both vehicles requested from insured for the file.

Entry 3: Received letter of representation from claimant's attorney. Attorney requests the policy limits, the insured's full driving history, and copies of all photos and statements. Acknowledged receipt. Advised that coverage review is ongoing and that a formal response will follow once the investigation is complete.

Entry 4: Obtained intersection signal timing records and the responding officer's report. Officer notes the claimant's vehicle was traveling above the posted limit. Claimant's medical records show a wrist fracture treated with surgical repair and a follow-up period of several weeks. Reserve adjusted to reflect the injury severity and attorney involvement.

Entry 5: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding a settlement demand. Demand package reviewed and found to include medical bills and wage loss documentation. Liability remains disputed due to conflicting accounts of the signal phase. Requested an independent medical exam and additional records. File referred to supervisor for evaluation of the demand and liability position.
